knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unidentified powder may be hazardous. Isolate and report it, never identify it by touch.
Appearance is not a reliable identification for asbestos or lead.
Regulated removal is for qualified and authorised specialists only.

practicalCriteria: Sorts ten photo-based hazard cards into routine, clarification or stop-work, and names the responsible person for each.
Isolates a simulated unidentified material and reports it without disturbing it.
Does not sample, sweep or identify any material by touch.
passRule: All ten cards sorted with the responsible person named, and the simulated unidentified material isolated and reported. Observed by an assessor. Not a licence.
stopWorkCriteria: Unidentified material swept, emptied or sampled
Area entered after an uncontrolled hazard is reported
